BAE Systems is a defense, aerospace, and security company developing technologies that support national security. The Software Engineer I will join the ES Defense software engineering team, contributing to coding, debugging, software integration, and testing of complex software and hardware systems while gaining exposure to the full software life cycle. The role also provides project rotations, mentorship, training, and collaboration opportunities for early-career engineers.
